source.title: Updated Overall Survival Analysis From IMpower110: Atezolizumab Versus Platinum-Based Chemotherapy in Treatment-Naive Programmed Death-Ligand 1-Selected NSCLC
source.source_type: updated/final overall-survival analysis of an open-label randomized phase 3 trial

source_integrity_notes: The high-or-intermediate PD-L1 overall-survival test failed at p=0.3091, so the hierarchical procedure did not formally test overall survival in the any-PD-L1 population.
The updated high-PD-L1 overall-survival analysis is exploratory; it is not represented as a new confirmatory hypothesis test.
The RPSFT analysis adjusting chemotherapy-arm survival for subsequent immunotherapy is post hoc and is separated from the randomized primary estimand.
Post-progression non-protocol treatment was not randomized or protocol-controlled; the source itself warns that these comparisons may be confounded and biased.
Biomarker and clinical subgroup results are preserved as exploratory subgroup findings, including wide confidence intervals where present.
All model-extracted atoms remain needs_review because no independent human reviewer step is represented.
No external verification of 2026 treatment standards, regulatory status, or current guideline alignment was performed because @VERIFY was not activated.
